items.title: Trump imposes 50% tariff on Canadian imports
items.description: The duties take effect within 30 days and mark a major escalation in trade tensions between the North American neighbours.

items.title: US launches fresh strikes on Iran, as Trump warns of retaliation for deaths of soldiers
items.description: The US says the attacks were aimed at degrading Iran's capabilities to attack ships in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Yemen's Houthis announce 'maritime embargo' on Saudi Arabia
items.description: The Houthis say the embargo begins immediately and is a response to a Saudi blockade of ports and airports in Yemen.

items.title: Tate brothers appear in US court for extradition proceedings
items.description: They were arrested on Saturday after the UK announced dozens of new charges, including rape and sex trafficking, which they deny.

items.title: Notorious drug cartel leader Ismael Zambada sentenced to life in US prison
items.description: Known as "El Mayo", the co-founder the Sinaloa Cartel was also ordered to pay $15bn after he admitted to sending vast amounts of drugs to the US.

items.title: Rare identical quadruplets born in Australia
items.description: The parents of the four naturally-conceived girls were taken by "immense surprise" with the pregnancy, the hospital said.

items.title: Ten killed as Russian attacks on merchant ships in Black Sea intensify
items.description: Russian strikes on the Odesa region have killed 28 people in July alone, local authorities say.

items.title: Boy, 13, dies during World Cup celebrations in Spain
items.description: Two other young people were injured after a fountain partially collapsed in Salamanca's Ciudad Rodrigo.

items.title: Police block thousands of 'cockroach' protesters marching on India's parliament
items.description: Some protesters demanding education reforms said they were injured in clashes with police who banned the march.

items.title: Merger deal between Paramount and Warner Bros paused by judge
items.description: US court temporarily stops Paramount and Warner Bros merging after 12 states launched legal action.

items.title: Hamas names Khalil al-Hayya as new overall leader
items.description: The Palestinian armed group's Qatar-based chief negotiator replaces Yahya Sinwar, who was killed by Israeli forces in Gaza in 2024.

items.title: Scores feared dead after passenger ferry capsizes off Guyana
items.description: Sixty-seven people have been rescued but the ferry is thought to have had more than 130 people on board.
